verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a chat platform like Zulip, so the axis applies. The pack has no documentation of any telemetry setting or opt-out control. Self-hosting and FOSS status are adjacent and do not count as a documented opt-out capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
